- Liveness baseline measured this shift (`mode:subagent`, S/M governed-text cards): dispatch → draft PR 32 / 35 / 49 minutes; the 45-minute probe threshold held without a probe. Queue latency observed: enqueue → MERGED 27 and 24 minutes with 2–3 entries ahead.
- Platform readings this shift: (1) a relay `issue_patch` carrying `body` on a PR number stored the bytes identical — no footer appended (the +58 bare-footer append is a session-token PATCH reading); (2) `Validate Package Dependencies` is path-filtered — a PR that only removes a `package.json` `scripts` line triggers it and inherits `main`'s OSV red (#22013); (3) a `Type Check · source gates` lane can be cancelled at `Checkout repository` after a ten-minute hang, turning the `TypeScript Type Check` aggregate red with no test body run — the one re-run case; (4) `pm:seat` `list_issues` with `body` in `fields` overflows the tool result, and MCP multi-label `list_issues` is a union — REST `labels=a,b` for AND; (5) a shell variable holding backticked text expands them when double-quoted — claim text goes through files, never variables.
- Timers: Routine `trig_01AGpv4wMw88KexCH41wPrGH`; every accelerator of this shift is spent (`trig_01T4LHrY7TC3DjPQezTetqD8`, `trig_01KjGiXQ5bm2i2VtChJceNZB`, `trig_01DLu5WePEJzqZ1vMC5zWKSB`, `trig_01VdUYxE617EcfXRowk1Zjm6`); standby relies on the Routine and the PR #22002 subscription.
